Key Responsibilities
Independently develop and optimize yeast extract-based application solutions across savory food categories, including soups, bouillons, sauces, and snack seasoning systems.
Lead formulation design and iterative prototyping for flavor enhancement, umami modulation, and taste rounding performance.
Conduct sensory evaluation and interpret sensory data to guide formulation decisions and product positioning.
Translate customer briefs and market requirements into robust technical solutions and scalable formulations.
Evaluate ingredient interactions within complex food matrices and troubleshoot formulation challenges.
Conduct competitor benchmarking and trend analysis in savory flavor systems and seasoning applications.
Support customer-facing technical projects, including sample development, troubleshooting, and technical presentations.
Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and regional/global R&D teams to support business-driven innovation.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, quality, and internal R&D standards.
 
Qualifications & Skills
Master's degree in Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related discipline.
Proven experience in formulation development in at least one application area (e.g., soups, bouillons, snack seasonings, sauces). Exceptional junior candidates with relevant academic or internship experience are also encouraged to apply. Strong sensory evaluation capability with structured sensory thinking and flavor profiling experience.
Solid understanding of ingredient functionality, flavor interactions, and food matrix behavior.
Ability to independently design experiments and interpret technical data.
Strong problem-solving skills in formulation troubleshooting and product improvement.
Good communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional and customerfacing environments.
Business-oriented mindset with ability to translate technical work into customer value.
Proficiency in English for global collaboration (written and spoken).
Willingness to travel for customer visits, trade shows in Europe, and knowledge exchange in headquarter China.
 
What We Offer
Opportunity to contribute to innovative savory flavor solutions shaping the future of food.
 Exposure to global R&D projects and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across different regions.
Professional development and career growth opportunities within a global biotechnology company.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber-optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables connecting offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks, while Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Based in Ghent, Fluves is a growing technology scale-up active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

 
 

Your role
 

As Field & Operations Technician, you will be part of the Fluves delivery team. You will support the practical and technical execution of customer projects, both on-site and from our Ghent office.
 

You will prepare, execute, verify and document the installation of fiber-optic cables and electronic equipment at locations in Belgium and neighbouring countries. You will work closely with project managers, technical experts, subcontractors and customers to ensure that delivery work is carried out safely, reliably and in accordance with Fluves’ quality standards.
 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is independent, responsible, customer-oriented and well organized.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Prepare and support fiber installations based on customer information, technical drawings and internal requirements. 

 

• Brief subcontractors before work starts, provide practical guidance during installation, and inspect and document the quality of the completed work. 

 

• Splice fiber-optic cables and repair damaged cables. 

 

• Record installed fiber routes and maintain accurate project documentation. 

 

• Prepare, test and configure equipment before shipment or installation. 

 

• Mount devices and prepare hardware for customer projects. 

 

• Prepare shipments and ensure that project materials are complete, correctly packed and properly documented. 

 

• Maintain and organize the Fluves warehouse, including equipment, tools, test setups and project materials. 

 

• Support project managers with practical technical tasks before, during and after project execution. 

 

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• Help ensure that installations, equipment and project documentation meet Fluves’ quality standards. 

 

• Follow all applicable safety procedures, identify and report hazards, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our working methods. 

 

• Act as Fluves’ operational lead on site and help ensure that Fluves personnel and subcontractors work in accordance with our safety and quality standards. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a solid practical technical background, ideally through a technical bachelor’s degree, graduate degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

 

• You are hands-on and comfortable working with technical equipment, power tools, cabling, racks, sensors and electrical components. 

 

• You work carefully and have a strong eye for detail, particularly when documenting installations, inspecting work or preparing equipment for customer projects. 

 

• You have a strong safety mindset and are willing to obtain the necessary safety certificates and training. 

 

• You are responsible, reliable and well organized. When you take on a task, others can trust that you will follow it through properly. 

 

• You can work independently and adapt to unforeseen situations in the field, while knowing when to ask for support or clarification. 

 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• You are comfortable working both on-site in industrial environments and in an office or warehouse environment. 

 

• You have a valid category B driving license and are willing to travel occasionally for customer projects, mainly within Belgium and neighbouring countries. 

 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch or French is an advantage. 

 

• You have a good working knowledge of standard office software, such as Excel, Word and Outlook, and are willing to learn to use specialized software packages. 

 

• Experience with AutoCAD or similar software is an advantage but not required. 

 

• Experience with fiber optics, electrical installations, industrial environments or applicable safety standards is an advantage but not required.

Do you thrive on solving complex infrastructure challenges and building reliable, scalable platforms?

As part of its continued investment in modern infrastructure and platform technologies, we are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to help design, evolve, and operate a secure, scalable, and high-performing AWS platform.

This is an opportunity to work on a modern AWS environment, drive automation, and contribute to the evolution of critical platforms supporting key business services.
Role
As a Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in the reliability, governance, and continuous improvement of the AWS platform.

Your responsibilities include:

• Design, manage, and continuously improve the AWS platform, ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and performance.
• Deploy and administer multi-account AWS environments following architecture best practices.
• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, Python, and Terraform.
• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines while integrating security throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
• Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions to proactively identify and resolve issues.
• Ensure platform security, governance, and compliance through IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, and internal security standards.
• Collaborate closely with development and infrastructure teams to integrate non-functional requirements such as security, automation, and scalability.
• Support development teams by promoting DevOps best practices and maintaining clear technical documentation.
• Contribute to the strategic evolution of the platform through continuous improvement initiatives and innovation.
Profile
We're looking for someone who combines strong AWS expertise with a passion for automation and platform engineering.

You have:

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, particularly:
• AWS Lambda
• Step Functions
• Redshift
• AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification (Professional certification is a plus).
• Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK and Python.
• Knowledge of Terraform is considered an asset.

• Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Experience with Git-based platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
• Experience with monitoring and observability tools, including CloudWatch and centralized logging solutions.
• Good understanding of platform security principles, including IAM, encryption, and vulnerability management.
• Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases.
• Experience designing or integrating REST APIs using tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI and Postman.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies is an advantage.Languages

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will be responsible for organising and supporting meetings, conferences and events while ensuring a seamless experience for employees, visitors and guests. You will coordinate event logistics, prepare meeting spaces, provide office support and act as a key contact to ensure successful event delivery in a dynamic workplace environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

Description

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

 

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

Our client is a well-established Belgian technology and entertainment company with over 30 years of history and a leading position in its sector. Operating across multiple European countries, the group combines innovative proprietary technology with a strong customer-centric approach to deliver digital and retail entertainment services.

With approximately 1,500 employees across Europe and nearly 500 employees based at its Belgian headquarters, the company continues to invest heavily in technology, innovation and international expansion. Recent developments include platform migrations, consolidation of international operations and the continued enhancement of internally developed digital products.

The legal department consists of a close-knit team of legal and regulatory specialists working collaboratively across several areas, including regulatory affairs, corporate law, commercial contracts, public affairs and employment law. The team offers a supportive environment where expertise sharing, autonomy and professional development are highly valued.

The company culture is entrepreneurial, dynamic and project-driven. Employees benefit from direct access to decision-makers, significant ownership of their responsibilities and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with tangible business impact.

Jobomschrijving

As Regulatory Officer, you will act as the primary legal and regulatory specialist for the Dutch market.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Serving as a key point of contact with Dutch authorities and regulatory bodies
• Coordinating regulatory interactions in collaboration with compliance, legal and external advisors
• Managing license maintenance, renewals and related regulatory obligations
• Overseeing all statutory notification requirements and submissions to Dutch authorities
• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact on business activities
• Translating regulatory requirements into practical internal processes, controls and guidelines
• Providing legal advice on commercial initiatives, marketing campaigns, partnerships and new product features
• Supporting internal stakeholders on regulatory risk assessments and compliance matters
• Coordinating litigation matters involving customers, business partners or authorities
• Managing escalated complaints with potential regulatory implications
• Advising on terms and conditions, promotional rules and responsible measures
• Supporting customer support, compliance and responsible gaming teams on legal matters
• Ensuring customer-facing processes remain aligned with applicable regulations
• Creating and maintaining internal regulatory guidelines and training materials
• Collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions

• Master's degree in Dutch Law
• Between 1 and 5 years of professional experience in a legal or regulatory environment
• Experience with Dutch law is essential
• Experience gained in private practice, in-house legal departments, regulatory bodies or compliance functions is welcomed
• Fluent Dutch and English, both written and spoken
• French is considered a strong asset
• Strong interest in regulatory and compliance matters
• Ability to analyse complex legal situations and provide pragmatic solutions
• Autonomous while maintaining a collaborative mindset
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment
• Willingness to travel occasionally to the Netherlands when required
• Good command of Microsoft Office tools and digital collaboration platforms

Personality-wise, our client is looking for someone who is transparent, approachable and communicative. The ideal candidate is comfortable acknowledging mistakes, seeks continuous improvement and enjoys working closely with colleagues in a relatively young and dynamic team environment.

Your responsibilities are

You make sure the proposals are in line with the operational excellence strategy. You are responsible for the improvement projects, both technical and organizational, from A to Z.

Studies and working experience
 
 
 
• Industrial engineering degree without experience or bachelor with experience 
 
• Experience in a production environment 
 
• Experience in project management is an asset 
 

Technical skills
 
 
 
• Good knowledge of Dutch 
 
• Knowledge of English / French

• Knowledge MES system 
 
• Knowledge MS Office / Excel 
 

Specific skills
 
 
 
• Analytic 
 
• Innovative

• Perform conversions in consultation with the senior mould exchanger.

• Preventively checking the weighing cells of the colouring machines.
• Fitting new PET rolls at the thermo machine and replacing full big baggies.
• Reporting production problems via the ticket system.
• Independently performing material and colour changes.

• Knowledge of general operating procedures within the company, specifically regarding food safety.
• Technical knowledge of injection moulding machines, injection moulding process. 
• knowledge of IML technology (in mould labeling) = very important!!!
• Technical knowledge to perform mould and machine checks.

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Good level of English

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
